name: Go Kart VR
summary:
Step into Go Kart VR and experience the thrill of next-level vr racing built for Meta Quest. Race across detailed environments, control powerful karts, and push your driving skills to the limit in fast-paced competitive gameplay.

Feel the realism of a true racing simulator with responsive handling, dynamic physics, and immersive VR tracks. Every race brings intense drift racing, tight corners, and high-speed straightaways where precision and timing matter. Compete on challenging tracks that test both begin
